title: Navigate the built docs through a lazily loaded Pagefind dialog

build.command: pnpm registry:build && pnpm gallery:manifest && pnpm --filter @rnr-ai-elements/docs build
build.note: 67 pages + the fifth island; ordered chain before the task-owned indexer.

index.note: Real Pagefind 1.5.2 (pnpm dlx, pinned) over completed dist; fail-closed destination check first; 63 pages indexed (56 items + 7 docs).

red.observed: 10/15 cases fail at the missing search surface (locator('[data-search-slot] button') never appears; no dialog, no Pagefind activation); 5/5 chromium-nojs cases pass because the no-JavaScript surface contract (hidden trigger, working links, zero pagefind requests) already holds on the preimplementation candidate.
